narrative.overview:
Daylight Flight Deck turns Signal into a bright operational research desk rather than a generic analytics dashboard. A fixed ink-blue rail anchors a cool paper canvas, while white evidence surfaces, compact outlined controls, and restrained state color make a dense investigative app feel calm and legible.

The system is evidence-first: opportunity cards keep identity, eligibility, proof metrics, confidence, and the plain-language reason for qualification in one sweep. Signal Green marks live, approved, selected, or successful state; Analysis Cobalt identifies analytical context, provenance, and technical detail; Agent and Autopilot actions remain transparent through progressive-disclosure audit patterns.
keyCharacteristics: Bright cool-paper workspace anchored by a fixed ink-blue rail.
Signal Green for live/approved state and Cobalt for analysis/provenance.
Compact desktop density with generous outer gutters and wrapped controls.
White cards over tonal inset surfaces, using one restrained ambient shadow.
Evidence-first opportunity cards and reversible, expandable Agent audits.

rules.name: The State Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Signal Green means live, allowed, selected, successful, or eligible; Amber means waiting or attention; Danger Red means failure or destructive intent.

rules.name: The Analysis Is Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Use Analysis Cobalt for interpretation, provenance, technical detail, and information—not for operational success.

rules.name: The Paper Before Chrome Rule
rules.body: Keep most of every screen in Cool Paper, White Evidence Surface, and quiet tonal insets; accent color should clarify state rather than decorate empty space.

rules.name: The Display Earns Its Weight Rule
rules.body: Reserve Bahnschrift for identity, hierarchy, and numbers that deserve instrument-like emphasis; do not set paragraphs or dense controls in it.

rules.name: The Minimum Is a Contract Rule
rules.body: Every primary workflow must remain complete, readable, and unclipped at 1040×700.

rules.name: The Evidence Stays in Reach Rule
rules.body: Wrap controls and collapse columns before separating identity, eligibility, metrics, rationale, or audit outcome from the surface where the operator makes the decision.

rules.name: The One Ambient Lift Rule
rules.body: Apply the ambient shadow to the outer decision surface only; nested evidence groups must remain flat.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Nesting Rule
rules.body: Outer cards use 14px corners; controls and icon tiles use 11–12px; inset evidence groups use 10px; only compact chips and identity circles become fully rounded.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Score Rule
rules.body: A score may lead the eye, but the card is incomplete without eligibility, sample size, leverage, recency, and a readable reason for qualification.

rules.name: The Audit Before Assurance Rule
rules.body: Never rely on an AI summary alone to imply what changed; show the tool, outcome, status, count, reversibility, and expandable detail as separate evidence.

dos: Do keep the Cool Paper canvas and fixed Ink Blue rail as the stable frame across all five screens.
Do use Signal Green for live/approved state and Analysis Cobalt for interpretation, provenance, and technical detail.
Do keep identity, eligibility, metrics, and “Why it qualifies” evidence together on every opportunity card.
Do wrap controls and collapse responsive columns so every workflow remains usable at 1040×700.
Do pair semantic color with text, icons, counts, or status words.
Do present Agent and Autopilot actions as reversible, plain-language, expandable audit evidence.
Do design loading, empty, success, stalled, and error states as first-class operational surfaces.
donts: Don't turn Signal into a generic dark analytics dashboard or copy another creator tool's branding.
Don't use Signal Green and Analysis Cobalt interchangeably; each has a distinct semantic job.
Don't surface an opportunity score without the sample, leverage, recency, and qualification rationale that support it.
Don't stack shadows, nested metric tiles, or decorative gradients inside evidence cards.
Don't hide tool outcomes, failures, or state changes inside prose-only Agent responses.
Don't rely on color alone or shrink essential labels below the established 10–11px support range.
Don't introduce mobile-only composition assumptions; preserve the enforced desktop minimum and wrapping behavior.
